title: heptapleurum tanjiewhoeianum
intro: Heptapleurum tanjiewhoeianum, commonly known as Tanji's fern, is a type of plant species in the family Araliaceae. It is native to the tropical forests of Borneo and is traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits. The plant has been found to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic properties, making it useful in treating a range of health issues, including fever, cough, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Tanji's fern include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
